concepts.title: Absolute Divine Unity (Yihud Ha-Shem)
concepts.definition: God is singular, indivisible, non-composite, eternal, incorporeal, and completely transcendent. Rejects all forms of dualism, polytheism, and Trinity.
primary_prooftexts: Isaiah 45:5-7 ('I am YHWH and there is no other...')
concepts.maimonidean_principles: Principles 1, 2, and 3 of Rambam's Thirteen Principles: God exists, God is an absolute non-composite unity, God is non-physical and without bodily form or accident.

types.name: Noahic Covenant
types.scope: All humankind (7 Noahide Laws: no idolatry, blasphemy, murder, theft, sexual immorality, eating flesh from living animal, establishing courts of justice). Non-Jews who observe these are righteous of the nations and merit the World to Come.

types.name: Abrahamic Covenant
types.scope: Abraham and his physical seed; sealed by circumcision (Brit Milah) and promise of Land.

types.name: Sinaitic Covenant
types.scope: The entire nation of Israel; mutual bilateral treaty accepting Torah and 613 Mitzvot.

concepts.title: Sin and Atonement without Original Sin
concepts.doctrine: Judaism does not teach that humanity inherits the moral guilt or fallen nature of Adam and Eve. Every human is born morally pure with a Yetzer Ha-Tov (inclination toward good) and Yetzer Ha-Ra (inclination toward self-interest/passion). Sin (chet) is a failure to hit the mark or violation of command, rectified directly through Teshuvah, restitution, and divine mercy (Ezekiel 18:20-23).

concepts.title: The Jewish Concept of Messiah (Mashiach)
criteria: Mortal human king, physical descendant of King David and Solomon via direct patrilineal lineage (Jer 23:5, 33:17).
Rebuilder of the Third Temple in Jerusalem (Ezekiel 37:26-28).
Ingatherer of all Jewish exiles from global dispersion back to the Land of Israel (Isaiah 11:12).
Inaugurator of universal disarmament and global peace: 'Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore' (Isaiah 2:4, Micah 4:3).
Universal knowledge of the One True God throughout the earth (Isaiah 11:9, Zechariah 14:9).
Full restoration of Torah observance and judicial Sanhedrin (Isaiah 1:26).
He does NOT die prior to completing these tasks. If a claimant is killed without achieving them, he is not the Messiah (Maimonides, Hilkhot Melakhim 11:4).
